edits.with: .brief.sp .sp-when > b{font:800 11.5px/1.3 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--criteria)} /* s141: only the rung tag is the uppercase label; a bold cutoff inside the when line stays a cutoff (s140 deferred display LOW) */

figure.w5a .w5skip .w5z{display:block;margin:0 0 4px}
.brief.sp figure.w5a + p.sp-note{padding-left:15px;padding-right:15px;margin-bottom:14px} /* s141 (s140 deferred display LOWs): the note under the workup aligns with the figure text and keeps its hover off the next heading */
figure.w5a .w5skip{padding-left:0;font-size:16px;line-height:23px} /* s141: on a phone the Skip text takes the full width; its label keeps the disc column */
